public.timeline.definition:
select
    a.owner_id,
    'activity'::text as event_type,
    a.id as event_id,
    a.occurred_at,
    a.kind,
    a.direction,
    a.title,
    a.body,
    a.outcome,
    a.organization_id,
    array(
      select ac.contact_id from activity_contacts ac where ac.activity_id = a.id
    ) as contact_ids
  from activities a
public.timeline.name: timeline
